statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis code I48.0 (atrial fibrillation) was billed
The diagnosis code I34.0 (mitral valve insufficiency) was billed
A cardiac event monitor (CPT 93271) was ordered
The cardiac event monitor is ordered to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes
The cardiac event monitor is ordered to guide further management and assess the burden of arrhythmia
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
